subject: Emergency patch + gated release: artifacts and audit traces for SIG review
messages:
From: Jordan King <security@finvault.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 31 Jul 2029 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Request: traces for emergency patch 2029-07-31 (SIG questionnaire follow-up)

Hi Kimberly —

Thanks again for the call earlier. As part of our SIG review and SOC 2 evidence pack we need end-to-end traces for the emergency patch you applied on 2029-07-31 (the fix that addressed the token-rotation race). Specifically we need:

- Change approval chain showing who signed off and timestamps (including emergency approver)
- The PR history and code review checklist for the PR that landed the fix (include reviewer comments)
- CI/CD job run logs that triggered the canary and final rollout (timestamps and job IDs)
- Vault/KMS ephemeral token issuance/lease records for the deploy (or explanation if ephemeral tokens were used)
- Any rollback/mitigation playbook executed and the Jira ticket linking the incident

Can you provide these artifacts or point us to a secure share? We prefer PDFs/CSV exports plus links to the authoritative Git/GitHub records. If you have an auditor contact (Elaine at AuditLane) please loop them in.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — we have a SIG deadline next week.

— Jordan
Security Engineer, FinVault
[Attachment: SIG-questionnaire-partial.pdf (PDF, 120KB)]

From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
To: Jordan King <security@finvault.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai, jordan_blake@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 31 Jul 2029 16:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: traces for emergency patch 2029-07-31 (SIG questionnaire follow-up)

Jordan — thank you, we can provide a consolidated packet. High level summary below and I27ve started assembling the artifacts.

What we will deliver (ETA by EOD Fri 2029-08-02):
- Signed change-approval-chain PDF with ERT (emergency response team) sign-offs
- PR export (PR #7891) including reviewer comments, CI status, and merge timestamp
- CI job logs: ci-e2e-runner and deploy-canary job runs for the canary/rollout
- Vault lease snapshot showing ephemeral token issuance and TTLs used for the deploy
- Rollback/mitigation notes and the Jira ticket SUP-4827 (includes timeline)

Quick notes: the patch followed our emergency change policy: emergency approver was Jordan Blake (CTO proxy), and we used short-lived Vault leases (30m TTL) for the deploy agent. We also executed a canary window (10m) with metrics gating; no rollback was required.

I27m copying Marissa (security ops) and Aditya (platform eng) to pull artifacts from their systems. Elaine, if you need the packet in a specific format for AuditLane please advise.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Head of Compliance, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: request-acknowledgement.txt]

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai, jordan_blake@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 01 Aug 2029 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: assembling evidence for FinVault SIG request (PR #7891 + CI traces)

Team — please pull the artifacts below and drop into the shared folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2bExampleLink

Requested items and owners:
- change-approval-chain-20290731.pdf (Marissa) 
  - Include time-synced approval entries from PagerDuty and internal Google Approval flow
- pr-7891-review-log.csv (Aditya) 
  - Export reviewer comments, review labels, and merge commit SHA
- ci-job-run-ci-e2e-20290731.log (Aditya)
  - Include raw job output plus CI metadata (job ID, runner, start/end times)
- vault-lease-snapshot-20290731.json (Priyom)
  - Lease IDs, principal, TTL, lease creation time, and revoke events if any
- deploy-canary-manifest.txt (Jordan Blake)
  - Canary manifest, canary metrics threshold, and the canary rollback condition

Notes on format: auditor prefers flattened CSV/PDFs; zip archives are fine but include a manifest.txt listing file provenance. Keep links in the Drive folder to the authoritative GitHub PR and Jira ticket.

Marissa

From: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 01 Aug 2029 13:40:00 -07:00

- pr-7891-review-log.csv (attached) — reviewers: sre-rotate, sec-review, eng-qa. Merge commit: a1b2c3d4e5.
- ci-job-run-ci-e2e-20290731.log (attached) — job ID ci-e2e-74219, started 2029-07-31T18:02:12Z, finished 2029-07-31T18:14:08Z. All tests green.

— Aditya

From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
To: Jordan King <security@finvault.com>, Elaine Torres <elaine.t@auditlane.io>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai, jordan_blake@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 02 Aug 2029 09:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Delivery: FinVault SIG packet — emergency patch 2029-07-31

Jordan / Elaine —

Attached is the consolidated evidence packet for the emergency patch on 2029-07-31. Contents included in the zip:

- change-approval-chain-20290731.pdf [signed approvals, emergency approver highlighted]
- pr-7891-review-log.csv [full review history and merge SHA]
- ci-job-run-ci-e2e-20290731.log [raw CI logs and job metadata]
- vault-lease-snapshot-20290731.json [ephemeral lease snapshots exported from Vault]
- deploy-canary-manifest.txt [manifest and observed metrics during canary window]
- manifest.txt [file provenance and authoritative links: GitHub PR, Jira SUP-4827]

Highlights and clarifications (short):
- Emergency approval: Jordan Blake approved at 2029-07-31T17:46:02Z per approval log.
- Vault: short-lived leases used with 30-minute TTLs; lease creation and consumer agent shown in vault-lease-snapshot. No long-lived tokens were minted.
- CI/CD: canary pipeline job deploy-canary-033 ran immediately post-merge; monitoring gating completed at 2029-07-31T18:24:00Z.
- Rollback: none executed; rollback playbook entry included showing steps that would have been taken.

Links and authoritative records: GitHub PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/7891  |  Jira SUP-4827  |  Evidence folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2bExampleLink/evidence/finvault-20290731

If AuditLane needs an alternative packaging (separate single-file PDFs for each artifact) let us know and we27ll repack. Happy to jump on a quick call tomorrow to walk through the artifacts.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Head of Compliance, Redwood Inference
[Attachments: change-approval-chain-20290731.pdf (PDF, 210KB); pr-7891-review-log.csv (CSV, 42KB); ci-job-run-ci-e2e-20290731.log (LOG, 1.2MB); vault-lease-snapshot-20290731.json (JSON, 85KB); deploy-canary-manifest.txt (TXT, 6KB)]
